paragraphs: We are a growth oriented independent energy company focused on the acquisition, development, and production of hydrocarbons in the Appalachian Basin. We are focused on creating shareholder value through the identification and disciplined development of low-risk, highly economic oil and natural gas assets while maintaining a strong and flexible balance sheet. Our operations are focused on the Utica Shale in eastern Ohio as well as our dry gas assets in both the Marcellus and Utica Shales in southwestern Pennsylvania, providing highly economic stacked development inventory that leverages shared infrastructure and operational efficiencies. Our portfolio is balanced across oil and natural gas assets, allowing us to optimize our development plan to respond to changes in commodity prices over time. Unless expressly stated otherwise, the operating and financial information presented in this Annual Report does not give effect to the completion of the Antero Acquisition or the Preferred Investment (each as defined herein).
Our corporate headquarters are in Morgantown, WV, and shares of our Class A common stock trade on the New York Stock Exchange (the "NYSE") under the ticker symbol "INR".

On February 23, 2026, we completed the acquisitions ("Antero Acquisition") of (i) certain rights, title and interests in upstream oil and gas properties, rights and related assets located in the State of Ohio (the "Upstream Assets") from Antero Resources Corporation, Antero Minerals LLC and Monroe Pipeline LLC (collectively, the "Upstream Sellers"), pursuant to that certain purchase and sale agreement (the "Upstream Purchase Agreement"), dated December 5, 2025, by and among INR Holdings, Northern Oil and Gas Inc. ("Northern") and the Upstream Sellers, for a combined cash purchase price of approximately $800 million and (ii) certain gathering, compression and transportation systems, water facilities and systems, equipment and related assets located in the counties of Belmont, Guernsey, Monroe, Noble and Washington, Ohio (the "Midstream Assets" and, together with the Upstream Assets, the "Antero Ohio Assets") from Antero Midstream LLC, Antero Water LLC and Antero Treatment LLC (collectively, the "Midstream Sellers") pursuant to that certain purchase and sale agreement (the "Midstream Purchase Agreement" and, together with the Upstream Purchase Agreement, the "Antero Purchase Agreements"), dated December 5, 2025, by and among INR Holdings, Northern and the Midstream Sellers, for a combined cash purchase price of approximately $400 million. We acquired an undivided 60% interest and Northern acquired an undivided 40% interest in each of the Upstream Assets and Midstream Assets.

The Upstream Assets include approximately 42,500 net surface acres in the Ohio Utica Shale across Guernsey, Noble, Belmont, and Monroe Counties, which are highly contiguous with and complementary to our existing Ohio operations. The assets include an estimated 370.1 Bcfe of proved reserves and approximately 110 identified undeveloped drilling locations across multiple phase windows.

The Midstream Assets include approximately 141 miles of natural gas gathering pipelines, with capacity to support up to 600 MMcf/d, and approximately 90 miles of freshwater and produced‑water infrastructure. These assets enhance our vertical integration and are expected to reduce operating costs, improve margins, and enable efficient full‑field development.

Infinity will operate substantially all of the Antero Ohio Assets pursuant to joint development and cooperation agreements entered into with Northern at closing. We funded the transaction with cash on hand, the proceeds of the Preferred Investment and borrowings under our Credit Facility, which was amended and expanded in connection with closing.

On February 23, 2026, Infinity issued and sold, pursuant to a Securities Purchase Agreement ("Securities Purchase Agreement") an aggregate 350,000 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock of the Company, par value $0.01 per share ("Series A Preferred Stock") to affiliates of Quantum Capital Group ("Quantum") and affiliates of Carnelian Energy Capital Management, L.P. ("Carnelian") (each a "Preferred Purchaser" and, collectively, the "Preferred Purchasers") for consideration of $350 million. After deducting placement agent fees, Infinity received net proceeds of approximately $337.1 million. Quantum acquired 275,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock and Carnelian acquired 75,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock (the "Preferred Investment"). The Company used the proceeds of the Preferred Investment to fund a portion of the Antero Acquisitions and will use any remaining proceeds for general corporate purposes.

On February 3, 2025, we completed our IPO of 15,237,500 shares of our Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share ("Class A common stock"), which includes 1,987,500 shares of Class A common stock issued and sold pursuant to the underwriters' exercise of their option in full to purchase additional shares of Class A common stock, at a price to the public of $20.00 per share ($18.80 per share net of underwriting discounts and commissions). After deducting underwriting discounts and commissions, we received net proceeds of approximately $286.5 million. We contributed all of the net proceeds from the IPO to INR Holdings. In turn, INR Holdings used all of the net proceeds from the IPO (net of underwriting discounts) after paying certain offering expenses to repay $285.0 million of outstanding borrowings under the Credit Facility.

In connection with the IPO, we underwent a Corporate Reorganization whereby: (a) the membership interests of the Legacy Owners in INR Holdings (including the Incentive Units, as defined in Item 11. "Executive Compensation—Narrative Disclosure to Summary Compensation Table—Long-Term Equity Incentive Compensation") were recapitalized into a single class of units (the "INR Units"), and, in exchange for their existing membership interests, the Legacy Owners received INR Units and an equal number of shares of Class B common stock, par value $0.01 per share ("Class B common stock"); and (b) we contributed the net proceeds of the IPO to INR Holdings in exchange for newly issued INR Units and a managing member interest in INR Holdings. Infinity is a holding company whose sole material asset consists of membership interests in INR Holdings. Infinity is the managing member of INR Holdings and controls and is responsible for all operational, management and administrative decisions relating to INR Holdings' business and consolidates the financial results of INR Holdings and reports non-controlling interests in its consolidated financial statements related to the INR Units that the Legacy Owners own in INR Holdings. As of December 31, 2025, we owned an approximate 25.6% common interest in INR Holdings and the Legacy Owners owned an approximate 74.4% common interest in INR Holdings.

Our operations are focused on the Utica Shale in eastern Ohio as well as the Marcellus Shale and the emerging dry gas Utica Shale in southwestern Pennsylvania. As of December 31, 2025, we held approximately 98,400 net surface acres across our core operating areas. headings: We could experience periods of higher costs if commodity prices rise. These increases could reduce our profitability, cash flow and ability to complete development activities as planned.
Risks Related to Our Reserves, Leases and Drilling Locations

Unless we replace our reserves with new reserves and develop those new reserves, our reserves and production will decline, which would adversely affect our future cash flows and results of operations.
Our identified drilling locations are scheduled out over many years, making them susceptible to uncertainties that could materially alter the occurrence or timing of their drilling.
Properties that we decide to drill may not yield oil, natural gas and NGLs in commercially viable quantities.
Seismic data is subject to interpretation and may not accurately identify the presence of drilling hazards, which could adversely affect the results of our drilling operations.
We may be unable to integrate the recently acquired Antero Ohio Assets successfully, or realize the anticipated benefits of the acquisition.
Drilling for and producing oil, natural gas and NGLs are high-risk activities with many uncertainties that could adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.
Part of our business strategy involves using some of the latest available horizontal drilling and completion techniques, which involve risks and uncertainties in their application.
Our producing properties are concentrated in the Appalachian Basin, making us vulnerable to risks associated with operating in one major geographic area.
The loss of one or more of the purchasers of our production could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.
We may incur losses as a result of title defects in the properties in which we invest.
We may be unable to make attractive acquisitions or successfully integrate acquired businesses, and any inability to do so may disrupt our business and hinder our ability to grow.

Changes in effective tax rates, or adverse outcomes resulting from other tax increases or an examination of our income or other tax returns, could adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.
paragraphs: Investing in our Class A common stock involves risks. You should carefully consider the following risks and uncertainties, as well as the other information contained in this Annual Report, including those described in "Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements." The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also materially affect our business. The occurrence of any of the following risks or additional risks and uncertainties that are currently immaterial or unknown could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, liquidity, results of operations and cash flows. The trading price of our Class A common stock could decline due to any of these risks, and you may lose all or part of your investment.

Oil, natural gas and NGL prices are volatile. A sustained decline in prices could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations, liquidity and our ability to meet our financial commitments or cause us to delay our planned capital expenditures.

Our revenues, operating results, profitability, liquidity and ability to grow depend primarily upon the prices we receive for the oil, natural gas and NGLs we sell. We require substantial expenditures to replace our oil, natural gas and NGL reserves, sustain production and fund our business plans, including our development and exploratory drilling efforts. Lower commodity prices negatively affect the amount of cash available for capital expenditures, could negatively affect our ability to borrow money or raise additional capital and, as a result, could have a material adverse effect on our business, prospects, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows. In addition, low prices may reduce the quantities of oil, natural gas and NGL reserves that may be economically produced and result in an impairment of our natural gas and oil properties.

Historically, the markets for oil, natural gas and NGLs have been volatile, and they are likely to continue to be volatile. Wide fluctuations in oil, natural gas and NGL prices may result from relatively minor changes in the supply of or demand for oil, natural gas and NGLs, market uncertainty and other factors that are beyond our control, including:
•worldwide and regional economic conditions impacting the supply and demand for oil, natural gas and NGLs, including inflationary pressures;
•changes in seasonal temperatures, including the number of heating degree days during winter months and cooling degree days during summer months;

paragraphs: 本公司為一間以成長為導向的獨立能源公司，專注於在阿巴拉契亞盆地進行天然氣與石油資源的取得、開發與生產。本公司透過識別並有紀律地開發低風險、高經濟效益的石油與天然氣資產，以創造股東價值，同時維持強而有彈性的資產負債表。我們的營運重點為位於俄亥俄州東部的尤蒂卡頁巖，以及位於賓夕法尼亞州西南部馬瑟爾斯與尤蒂卡頁巖的乾氣資產，提供高經濟效益的疊層開發存貨，並利用共用基礎設施與營運效率。本公司資產組合於石油與天然氣之間取得平衡，使我們能根據商品價格的變化，優化開發計畫。除非另有明確說明，否則本年度報告中所呈現的營運與財務資訊，均未考量完成安特羅收購或優先投資（各項定義請參見 herein）後的影響。
本公司總部設於西弗吉尼亞州摩根敦，本公司A類普通股於紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）交易，股票代碼為"INR"。

於 2026 年 2 月 23 日，本公司完成收購（"Antero Acquisition"）（i）位於美國俄亥俄州（"Upstream Assets"）的上游石油及天然氣財產、權利及相關資產，來自 Antero Resources Corporation、Antero Minerals LLC 與 Monroe Pipeline LLC（合稱 "Upstream Sellers"），根據 2025 年 12 月 5 日由 INR Holdings、Northern Oil and Gas Inc.（"Northern"）與 Upstream Sellers 簽訂之買賣契約（"Upstream Purchase Agreement"），以總計約 800 百萬美元現金購入，以及（ii）位於俄亥俄州 Belmont、Guernsey、Monroe、Noble 與 Washington 縣之集氣、壓縮與輸送系統、水設施與系統、設備及相關資產（"Midstream Assets" 且與 Upstream Assets 合稱 "Antero Ohio Assets"），來自 Antero Midstream LLC、Antero Water LLC 與 Antero Treatment LLC（合稱 "Midstream Sellers"），根據 2025 年 12 月 5 日由 INR Holdings、Northern 與 Midstream Sellers 簽訂之買賣契約（"Midstream Purchase Agreement" 且與 Upstream Purchase Agreement 合稱 "Antero Purchase Agreements"），以總計約 400 百萬美元現金購入。本公司取得 Upstream Assets 與 Midstream Assets 各 60% 不分擔權益，Northern 取得 Upstream Assets 與 Midstream Assets 各 40% 不分擔權益。
上游資產包含約42,500英畝的Ohio州尤蒂卡頁巖地表權，分佈於Guernsey、Noble、Belmont與Monroe縣，與本公司現有Ohio州營運高度連續且互補。這些資產包含約370.1 億立方英尺的已證儲量，以及約110個已識別的未開發鑽探點，分佈於多個開發階段。
中游資產包含約141英里天然氣集輸管線，容量可支持至600 十億立方英尺每日，以及約90英里淡水與產水設施。這些資產強化了我們的垂直整合，預期將降低營運成本、提高毛利率，並實現高效的全場開發。
Infinity將根據與Northern在交易完成時簽訂的共同開發與合作協議，經營 substantially all 的安特羅Ohio資產。本公司以現金、優先投資所得資金與信用融資的貸款資金（該貸款融資已根據交易完成進行修改與擴張）資助該交易。

於2026年2月23日，Infinity根據證券買賣協議（"證券買賣協議"）發行並出售本公司350,000股A類可轉換優先股，每股面額為0.01美元（"A類優先股"），予Quantum資本集團的關係企業（"Quantum"）與Carnelian能源資本管理有限公司的關係企業（"Carnelian"）（各為"優先投資者"，合稱"優先投資者"），總計金額為350 百萬美元。扣除經紀費用後，Infinity收到約337.1 百萬美元的淨資金。Quantum取得275,000股A類優先股，Carnelian取得75,000股A類優先股（"優先投資"）。本公司使用優先投資所得資金，用以資助安特羅收購的部分，並將任何剩餘資金用於一般企業用途。

於2025年2月3日，本公司完成發行15,237,500股本公司A類普通股，每股面額為0.01美元（"A類普通股"），包含1,987,500股A類普通股，根據經紀人完全行使其認購權所發行與出售，發行價格為每股20.00美元（每股淨收入為18.80美元，扣除經紀折扣與佣金）。扣除經紀折扣與佣金後，本公司收到約286.5 百萬美元的淨資金。本公司將IPO所得淨資金全數轉入INR控股公司。INR控股公司則將IPO所得淨資金（扣除經紀折扣後）經支付部分發行費用後，用以償還285.0 百萬美元的信用融資貸款餘額。

配合首次公開發行股票（IPO），我們進行了公司重整，內容如下：(a) 遺留股東在 INR Holdings 的會員權益（包括激勵單位，如 Item 11 "高階管理階層報酬—總計報酬表說明—長期股票激勵報酬" 所定義）被重新資本化為單一類別的單位（"INR 單位"），並以現有會員權益交換取得 INR 單位及相同數量的 Class B 普通股，每股面值為 0.01 美元（"Class B 普通股"）；以及 (b) 我們將 IPO 的淨資金貢獻至 INR Holdings，以交換取得新發行的 INR 單位及 INR Holdings 的管理會員權益。Infinity 是一家控股公司，其唯一重要的資產為 INR Holdings 的會員權益。Infinity 是 INR Holdings 的管理會員，並控制並負責 INR Holdings 事業的所有營運、管理及行政決策，並合併 INR Holdings 的財務結果，於其合併財務報表中報導非控制性權益，與遺留股東在 INR Holdings 所持有的 INR 單位有關。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們持有約 25.6% 的 INR Holdings 普通權益，遺留股東持有約 74.4% 的 INR Holdings 普通權益。
我們的業務重點為美國俄亥俄州東部的 Utica 石墨層，以及美國賓夕法尼亞州西南部的 Marcellus 石墨層與正在興起的乾氣 Utica 石墨層。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們在核心營運區域持有約 98,400 約束地表英畝。下表提供我們約束地表英畝、約束經營生產井及總鑽探潛力的總結，按石墨層分區（包括潛在雙層開發的英畝）：

paragraphs: 於 2026 年 2 月 23 日，本公司與 Northern 完成 Antero 收購 Upstream 資產自 Upstream 賣方，以及 Midstream 資產自 Midstream 賣方。Upstream 資產包括約 42,500 平方英里之淨地面上英里在 Ohio Utica Shale 跨越 Guernsey、Noble、Belmont 與 Monroe 縣，這些資產與本公司現有 Ohio 運作高度連續且具有補充性。資產包含約 370.1 億立方英尺之已證實儲備，以及約 110 個已識別之未開發鑽井位置，跨越多個階段窗口。Midstream 資產包括約 141 英里之天然氣集氣管線，容量可支援至多 600 千立方英尺每日，以及約 90 英里之淡水與產水基礎設施。這些資產強化本公司之垂直整合，預期可降低營運成本、改善毛利率，並實現高效之全場開發。
Infinity 將根據與 Northern 在交易關閉時簽訂之共同開發與合作協議，運營 substantially all 之 Antero Ohio 資產。本公司以現金、Preferred Investment 之所得及 Credit Facility 之借款資金資助此交易，該 Credit Facility 已於交易關閉時進行修改與擴充。

headings: 與商品價格相關的風險
若商品價格上漲，我們可能面臨較高的成本期間。這些成本增加可能降低我們的獲利能力、現金流量及完成預定開發活動的能力。
與我們的儲備、租約及鑽井地點相關的風險
除非我們以新儲備取代原有儲備並開發這些新儲備，否則我們的儲備及產量將下降，這將不利於我們未來的現金流量及營運成果。
我們識別出的鑽井地點根據多年進行排程，使其容易受到不確定因素的影響，這些因素可能重大地改變其鑽井發生或時間。
我們決定鑽探的屬性可能無法以商業上可行的數量產生石油、天然氣及NGLs。
地震資料會受到解讀的影響，可能無法準確識別鑽井危險的存在，這可能對我們的鑽井營運結果產生不利影響。
與我們的營運相關的風險
本公司可能無法成功整合最近取得的Antero Ohio Assets，或實現該併購預期的效益。
鑽探並生產石油、天然氣及NGLs為高風險活動，伴隨許多不確定因素，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司業務策略之一係使用目前可取得的最新水平鑽井及完井技術，這些技術在應用時涉及風險與不確定性。
本公司生產性資產集中於Appalachian Basin地區，使本公司易受單一主要地理區域營運風險影響。
若失去一個或多個本公司生產產品的買方，可能對本公司業務、營運成果、財務狀況及現金流產生不利影響。
本公司可能因投資的資產產權瑕疵而產生損失。
本公司可能無法進行具吸引力的收購或成功整合所取得的業務，若無法做到此點，可能幹擾本公司業務並阻礙本公司成長能力。
有效稅率的變動，或因其他稅率提高或本公司所得或其他稅務申報遭審查而產生的不利結果，可能對本公司營運成果及財務狀況產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 投資本公司A類普通股具有風險。您應仔細考慮下列風險與不確定性，以及本年度報告中所包含的其他資訊，包括「關於前瞻性陳述的警示聲明」。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險，可能尚未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要，也可能對本公司業務產生重大影響。任何上述風險或目前尚屬不重要或未知的其他風險與不確定性之發生，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、流動性、營運成果與現金流產生重大且不利的影響。本公司A類普通股的交易價格可能因上述風險而下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。
原油、天然氣與NGL價格波動性高。價格持續下跌可能對本公司業務、財務狀況與營運成果、流動性以及履行財務義務的能力造成不利影響，或導致本公司延後預定的資本支出。

本公司之營收、營運成果、獲利能力、流動性與成長能力，主要取決於本公司銷售原油、天然氣與NGL所獲得之價格。本公司需要大量支出以補充原油、天然氣與NGL儲備、維持生產並支應業務計畫，包括開發與探勘鑽井工作。商品價格下跌會影響可用於資本支出之現金數量，可能對本公司借款能力或籌措額外資金的能力產生負面影響，進而對本公司業務、前景、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流產生重大不利影響。此外，低價格可能減少可經濟性生產之原油、天然氣與NGL儲備數量，並導致本公司天然氣與石油資產減值。
歷來，原油、天然氣與NGL之市場均波動性高，未來亦可能持續如此。原油、天然氣與NGL價格之大幅波動可能源自於供應或需求之微小變化、市場不確定性及其他因素，而這些因素均超出本公司控制範疇，包括：
• 全球及區域經濟狀況影響原油、天然氣與NGL之供應與需求，包括通貨膨脹壓力；
• 季節性氣溫變化，包括冬季月份之供暖度日數與夏季月份之冷卻度日數
